name: 8192 BPE + Recurrent Factored Embedding + Parallel Muon
blurb: Moonshot 16MB submission scaffold using an 8192-token SentencePiece tokenizer, factored tied embeddings, and a shared-depth recurrent banked transformer on top of the March 23 Parallel Muon stack. Unique blocks are reused across recurrent loops via loop adapters to buy more effective depth per stored parameter. Metrics pending verification.
